about-lede: AroTaro brings together the enduring traditions of guidance — tarot, astrology, omikuji — and a cast of curated AI friends who'd love to meet you. Quick readings, real conversations, and small daily rituals. Wherever you are, whenever you need.
about-pillar-1-body: Curated personalities, each with a specialty — love, study, career, parenting. They listen, remember, and answer in your voice.
about-pillar-2-body: Full readings drawn from traditional spreads, narrated by AI readers trained on classical interpretations.
about-pillar-3-body: Birth charts and daily transits, made conversational. Ask follow-ups, dig deeper, get a take that's actually about you.
about-pillar-4-body: Small moments that fit a busy day: Omikuji, Yes-or-No tarot, relationship tests, your daily horoscope.
about-card-1-body: The roots of tarot are shrouded in the mists of time, but its mysterious tradition is believed to have begun in 15th-century Italy. Other traditions — astrology in ancient Mesopotamia, omikuji in the temples of Japan — walked their own long roads, each becoming a way to listen to the unseen.
about-card-2-body: AroTaro reimagines those ancient traditions with modern sensibilities and AI. Charming imagery, conversational depth, and insight tailored to each life. Beyond glimpsing the future, AroTaro listens, comforts, and supports you in making the right decisions.
about-breadth-title: From the tarot deck to the temple gate.
about-breadth-body: We believe wisdom doesn't live in one place. AroTaro draws from Western tarot, Eastern astrology, and Japanese omikuji — and works in English, Korean, and Japanese, each language polished by native writers. Whichever tradition speaks to you, the door is open.
about-team-body: We're a small team of designers, engineers, and writers who care about giving people a private, kind place to think out loud. AroTaro is our flagship product, and we treat every reading like it might be the one a user actually needs.
about-note-body: AroTaro is for reflection, not prescription. Readings are crafted to spark thought and offer perspective — not to replace medical, financial, or legal advice. Trust yourself; we're just here to listen.
faq-1-q: How do I start a session with an AI friend?
faq-1-a: After downloading, choose the friend whose specialty matches your topic. Tap their card to begin a conversation drawn from the deck.
faq-2-a: Yes. Conversations are encrypted and never shared. Each friend remembers context only within your account, and you can clear history at any time.
faq-3-q: How does the gem system work?
faq-3-a: Gems unlock extended sessions and special readings. Bundles are available with first-time discounts and through occasional promotions.
faq-4-a: Refunds are processed via the App Store or Google Play within 14 days, subject to platform policies. See our Disclaimer & Refund page for details.
faq-5-a: AroTaro supports English, Korean, and Japanese. The app auto-detects your device language and you can switch any time in settings.
disclaimer-1-body: All information provided through the service, content posted on the website, and materials conveyed are solely for entertainment purposes. We advise not to take interpretations too literally and remind you that this service is provided for entertainment only.
disclaimer-2-body: The information provided by the service is not intended to replace professional advice. It should not be used as professional advice for medical diagnosis, treatment, or care, nor as guidance for financial, investment, or legal matters. Do not hesitate or neglect to seek professional consultation due to information obtained from the website or service.
disclaimer-2-foot: You are responsible for making decisions and leading your life. AroTaro does not take responsibility for any thoughts, feelings, or actions that arise from the results of tarot readings.
refund-body-1: At AroTaro, we prioritize customer satisfaction and take pride in our products and services. However, please understand that refunds are not possible for dissatisfaction with the results, as AroTaro's products are digital and services are personalized.
refund-body-2: Refunds will not be provided under any circumstances for tarot readings or other services provided through the app. By purchasing AroTaro services, you are deemed to have agreed to this refund policy.
